title: Research Continuity Grants for Africa
institution: UNESCO and The World Academy of Sciences (TWAS)

compensation.value: Up to USD 2,000 per grant (six grants)
compensation.evidence_quote: Six grants of up to USD 2,000 each

about: Under UNESCO's Science for Crisis Response and Solutions Programme, six grants of up to USD 2,000 each help African scientists at African institutions resume or complete natural-sciences research interrupted by conflict or natural or biological hazards. Deadline: 15 November 2026.
requirements: African scientists based at recognized universities or research institutions in Africa
Research in the natural sciences interrupted by conflict or by natural or biological hazards

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research in the natural sciences interrupted by conflict or by natural or biological hazards" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"African scientists based at recognized universities or research institutions in Africa" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
